facts.text: The resort sits on the shores of Lake LBJ.
facts.excerpt: Horseshoe Bay Resort – An Oasis on the Shores of Lake LBJ

facts.text: The resort is in the Texas Hill Country.
facts.excerpt: Retreat to our world-class destination in the Texas Hill Country.

facts.text: The resort has a waterfront spa.
facts.excerpt: at a rejuvenating waterfront spa

facts.text: The resort has a marina, the Bayside Spa and a Waterfront Beach.
facts.excerpt: Spacious lakeside condominiums nestled in the resort close to the Marina, Bayside Spa, and Waterfront Beach.

facts.text: The resort has three Robert Trent Jones, Sr. golf courses.
facts.excerpt: Play unlimited golf on three world-class Robert Trent Jones, Sr. courses.

facts.text: The resort's golf courses were designed by World Golf Hall of Fame members Robert Trent Jones, Sr., and Jack Nicklaus.
facts.excerpt: designed by World Golf Hall of Fame members Robert Trent Jones, Sr., and Jack Nicklaus

facts.text: The Club at Horseshoe Bay Resort offers four championship golf courses.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy four championship golf courses, spa, tennis and pickleball facilities, a comprehensive marina

facts.text: The resort has five golf courses.
facts.excerpt: Golf enthusiasts visit for the five golf courses, three of them award winning

facts.text: The Tower has hotel rooms and suites with views of the property and the Texas Hill Country.
facts.excerpt: Luxury hotel rooms and suites with spectacular property and Texas Hill Country views.

facts.text: The Palm Presidential is the largest hotel suite, with a kitchenette, dining table, stone fireplace and separate living space.
facts.excerpt: Our largest hotel suite with a kitchenette, dining table, stone fireplace and separate living space.

facts.text: The Magnolia Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows and a balcony with views of the hotel pool or Lake LBJ.
facts.excerpt: A spacious layout with two rooms, floor-to-ceiling windows and a balcony with views of either the hotel pool or Lake LBJ.

facts.text: The Executive Suite has views of Lake LBJ from a furnished private balcony.
facts.excerpt: A one-room suite with an additional living space and expansive views of Lake LBJ, best enjoyed from the furnished private balcony.

facts.text: The Palm Villas each feature a unique mix of furniture styles and suit families or groups.
facts.excerpt: each featuring a unique mix of furniture styles, perfect for families or groups

facts.text: The one-bedroom Palm Villas are Tuscan inspired, with a kitchenette and a private balcony or patio with resort views.
facts.excerpt: Ideal for families, our Tuscan inspired one-bedroom Palm Villas accommodate four and include a living and dining space with a kitchenette. Features private balcony or patio with resort views.

facts.text: Guests of the Private Homes and Signature Residences have access to the Yacht Club's outdoor amenities, including a lagoon-style pool and a white sandy lakeside beach.
facts.excerpt: Guests of the Private Homes and Signature Residences have access to the member-exclusive Yacht Club outdoor amenities including a lagoon-style pool, a 27-person premiere hot tub, and a white sandy lakeside beach

facts.text: Rooms are designed in neutral grays and cream, with a contemporary feel.
facts.excerpt: Designs are bathed in neutral grays and cream that come off as contemporary with slightly mod touches in the armchairs and lamps.

facts.text: Marble bathrooms have clean modern lines and walk-in showers.
facts.excerpt: Marble bathrooms have clean modern lines and walk-in showers

facts.text: The resort has multiple tennis and pickleball courts, a full-service spa, several pools and a kids club.
facts.excerpt: there are multiple tennis and pickle ball courts, a full-service spa, several pools, and a kids club

facts.text: Staff can organize sunset cruises on the lake or area wine tours.
facts.excerpt: Staff can organize sunset cruises on the lake, or area wine tours

facts.text: The resort offers kayak, paddleboard and boat rentals and has a yacht club and marina.
facts.excerpt: kayak, paddleboard, and boats rentals, as well as with its yacht club and marina

facts.text: The resort has an airport and jet center with hangar spaces and aircraft parking.
facts.excerpt: there’s an airport and jet center with hangar spaces and aircraft parking

facts.text: The resort covers 7,000 acres combining a country club and a lakeside yacht venue.
facts.excerpt: 7,000 acres of country club meets lakeside yacht venue

facts.text: Horseshoe Bay Resort has a history as a high-end wedding venue.
facts.excerpt: has a history of being a high-end wedding venue

facts.text: Dining across the resort includes steak, Texas barbecue, Gulf Coast seafood and spa-inspired dishes.
facts.excerpt: There is steak, Texas barbecue and Gulf Coast seafood of course, but also healthy spa-inspired dishes.

facts.text: Some restaurants have specific dress codes.
facts.excerpt: Some restaurants have specific dress codes

facts.text: The resort's 2026 Wine, Dine & Jazz Festival features celebrity chefs and jazz performances.
facts.excerpt: The 2026 Wine, Dine & Jazz Festival features celebrity chefs, jazz performances, and creative culinary experiences throughout the weekend.

facts.text: The resort describes itself as a world-class destination offering approachable luxury.
facts.excerpt: Experience approachable luxury on award-winning golf courses

contradictions.note: p1 (official membership text) says four championship golf courses; p11 (CNT) says five golf courses. WhataHotel also claims the only RTJ Sr. course in Texas, while p1 lists three RTJ Sr. courses at the resort.
